findings.text: follow-on: the declared write paths name an evidence fragment and a figure directory that the diff does not produce, so the node lands no durable evidence artifact of its own.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against base 3ab626d41; 483f81dc3 adds the regression test and 0f6c5f929 introduces plan_review.py:598 _fingerprint_forms, rewires recovery.py:490-501 and routing.py:2613-2697 to the plan= parameter, and removes routing.py's hand-written {current, legacy} set.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when asks for a test storing a review under the legacy digest and asserting the sweep composes no review while the gate admits a build, the three named test files at 0 failed, and a negative control that reddens the no-compose case; tests/test_review_plan_command.py:219 test_sweep_and_gate_accept_the_same_review does exactly that, the gate log reports the four-file run at 65 passed EXIT=0, and negative-control.log shows 2 failed over the legacy no-compose cases with EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is that one function in reckon/crew/plan_review.py returns the set of digests a plan's current content may be joined by and that the gate, sweep eligibility and composer read it without recovery.py or routing.py spelling the pair; reckon/crew/plan_review.py:598 _fingerprint_forms returns exactly that frozenset and recovery.py:494 _plan_review_pending and routing.py:2697 require_plan_reviewed now reach it through the new plan= parameter, matching the node's account.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest reports status complete, commits 483f81dc3 and 0f6c5f929, the four-file head gate, the ledger gate, the negative control and the zero-added-failure pair; the gate, ledger, negative-control and reproduction logs it names are present on disk under the run directory and were read.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The prompt fenced plan_review.py, recovery.py, routing.py, tests/test_review_reflex_sweep.py, tests/test_review_plan_command.py plus an evidence fragment and a figure directory; the diff touches only plan_review.py, recovery.py, routing.py and tests/test_review_plan_command.py, so every changed path is inside the grant though the declared fragment and figure were not produced.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log shows test_sweep_and_gate_accept_the_same_review[stored-legacy] and [delivered-legacy] failing when _plan_review_pending reads the current digest alone, so the added assertion reddens on the reinstated regression.
justifications.evidence: baseline-regression.log reproduces the legacy-review re-dispatch at 2 failed, gate.log reports 65 passed EXIT=0 over the four files, and negative-control.log reddens the two legacy no-compose cases at EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: plan_review.py:598 is a private helper extending the existing plan_review owner and the public definition count holds at 13 to 13, though the composer's sidecar write at recovery.py:593 still computes the current digest alone rather than reading the shared set.
justifications.goal_fidelity: plan_review.py:598 is the one function that returns the current and legacy digests together and both recovery.py:494 and routing.py:2697 read it via plan=, with the interface probe confirming neither site computes a digest itself.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path (plan_review.py, recovery.py, routing.py, tests/test_review_plan_command.py) lies inside the grant, though the declared evidence fragment and figure directory were not authored.
